runpod.note: Self-hosted RunPod-serverless models (Flux-TTS-S2T, qwen-image-gen/edit). Concurrency is gated per-endpoint (COUNTER#runpod:*), not by this global limit; account-wide worker cap is 10 (20 post-$200).

lambda.note: QM-owned Lambda rungs (currently just QM-merge — see adapters/lambdamerge.ts). IAM-authenticated same-account invoke, no API secret. Not a fleet.ts entry — Lambda concurrency isn't a fixed pod count the way RunPod worker counts are, so this global limit (not a per-endpoint counterKey) is the concurrency gate.

runcomfy.note: RunComfy InfiniteTalk (community/infinite-talk fast + fast/multi) — Dialogue Basic/Premium lip-sync. External, per-second billed — NOT part of the RunPod fleet/ACCOUNT_CAP (fleet.ts has no entry for it; router.ts's isInternalRung() correctly treats it as external since it carries no endpointId). No spend-ceiling mechanism yet (storystudio-dialogue-qm-sfn-handoff.md §10 open question 5, unresolved as of 2026-08-08).

image.basic.t2i.note: Re-pointed 2026-08-11: rnqxi6c0mlq517 (Flux-TTS-ANIM) now serves TTS only (['tts','voice_clone_prompt'] per a live RunPod error) — T2I moved to the qwen-image-gen endpoint, still requesting the Flux Klein 4B model via the `model` field (see runpod.ts's t2i case).

image.explainer.t2i.note: Explainer/educational/advertisement/documentary/product-promotion T2I — self-hosted Qwen-Image-Gen. Replaces ERNIE-Image-Turbo (2026-07-21): these 5 genres generate text-free images now (StoryStudio, since 2026-07-11) — on-screen text is composited afterward as an animated Remotion overlay onto the frame's rendered clip (docs/quartermaster/remotion-overlay-lambda-integration-handoff.md), because diffusion-rendered text smudges once the still frame is animated into video. ERNIE's dense-EN-text strength is no longer the deciding factor for a model that never renders text at all, so this tier now uses the same plain t2i model already used elsewhere rather than keeping a dedicated text-rendering endpoint alive.
Explainer T2I fallback — Google nano-banana. Plain t2i fallback (no longer needs any special text-rendering strength — see the primary rung's note).

image.premium.t2i.note: Re-pointed 2026-08-11 (see image.basic.t2i's note) — still Flux Klein 4B via qwen-image-gen's `model` field. (Also the movie-basic image t2i via alias — not aliased for i2i, so this move is safe here.)

image.narrationBasic.t2i.note: Narration Basic image T2I — re-pointed 2026-08-11 (see image.basic.t2i's note) from flux-tts-s2t mode:image to qwen-image-gen mode:t2i, still Flux Klein 4B via the `model` field.

image.narrationBasic.i2i.note: Narration Basic image I2I — re-pointed 2026-08-11 (see image.basic.t2i's note) from flux-tts-s2t mode:image+reference_images to the dedicated qwen-image-edit endpoint (mode:i2i, single reference image via image_url — see runpod.ts's i2i case). Model is qwen-image-edit's own editing model, not Flux; unlike t2i, this endpoint has no Flux variant to select via `model`.

voice.narrationBasic.tts.note: Narration Basic TTS — self-hosted Kokoro-82M (Flux-TTS-S2T mode:tts engine:kokoro).

image.narrationPremium.t2i.note: Narration Premium image T2I (reference-less scene-shot frames — StoryStudio always sends a character reference for the rest, → i2i on qwen-image-edit). Re-pointed 2026-08-11 (see image.basic.t2i's note) from flux-tts-s2t mode:image to qwen-image-gen mode:t2i, still Flux Klein 4B via the `model` field — the old 'held at 0 workers' caveat is moot now that this tier's T2I lives on qwen-image-gen for real, not just as an unused fallback slot.

image.narrationPremium.i2i.note: Narration Premium image I2I — self-hosted Qwen-Image-Edit (qwen-image-edit endpoint).

voice.narrationPremium.tts.note: Narration Premium TTS — self-hosted Qwen Voice Design (Flux-TTS-S2T mode:tts engine:qwen). No external fallback for now — Google TTS (gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview) is reserved for the UI-facing voice.premium.tts ladder, not wired here as DR; also wouldn't carry a cloneArtifactUrl/voiceUrl clone through anyway (see runpod.ts).

voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedQwen.note: 4lang localized TTS for Narration Basic projects — same physical Qwen Voice Design/clone rung as voice.narrationPremium.tts, split into its own key purely for billing/audit attribution (mirrors bgm.narrationBasic/bgm.narrationPremium). Since 2026-07-10 the ASL (pipeline-stack.ts localizationStates) sends a per-language cloneArtifactUrl resolved by StoryStudio (voice.narrationClone.pt per language, per qwen-voice-clone/docs/voice-catalog.json) — the clone_artifact_url fast path (runpod.ts) fires the same as the primary QMGenerateTTSClone leg. Qwen has no Hindi voices at all (voice-catalog.json: every es-es-*/pt-br-* entry is a Qwen clone; every hi-in-* entry is Kokoro), so only es/pt-BR realistically route here. webhookCompletion:true (2026-07-25) — this rung synthesizes the WHOLE translated script in one call (not per-frame), which can genuinely exceed any single Lambda's wait window; RunPod's async webhook completion (executor.ts) + the SFN's waitForTaskToken (pipeline-stack.ts ttsTask()) replace the old blocking-poll-in-one-Lambda path that timed out at 850s for both es/pt live 2026-07-25.

voice.narrationPremium.ttsLocalizedQwen.note: 4lang localized TTS for Narration Premium projects — same rung as voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedQwen, split for billing/audit attribution only.

voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedKokoro.note: 4lang localized TTS for Narration Basic projects. `fixed` is now a FALLBACK, not a hard override (changed 2026-07-10, runpod.ts) — an explicit params.voiceId + params.language (sent per-language by pipeline-stack.ts localizationStates, resolved to lang_code via runpod.ts's KOKORO_LANG_CODE map) take priority, so this one rung can serve any Kokoro-backed language, not just Hindi. hf_alpha/lang_code=h (Kokoro's Hindi pack) is loaded on this pod despite the handler's voice-list comment only documenting American/British English — verified live 2026-07-08 (Whisper round-trip kept full meaning, minor phonetic drift on 2 words). Spanish/Portuguese Kokoro voices (ef_*/pf_* per kokoro_voice_reference in qwen-voice-clone/docs/voice-catalog.json) exist upstream but are NOT yet verified on this pod or sampled into the product voice catalog (used_in_catalog:false) — if a Basic project sends a voiceId for es/pt-BR expecting Kokoro, that path is untested until someone runs the same verification Hindi got. webhookCompletion:true (2026-07-25) — see voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedQwen's note; same whole-script-in-one-call duration risk applies to Kokoro.

voice.narrationPremium.ttsLocalizedKokor.note: 4lang localized TTS for Narration Premium projects — same rung as voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedKokoro (including the fixed-as-fallback behavior), split for billing/audit attribution only.

voice.narrationBasic.ttsFrameLocalizedQw.note: fourLang per-frame full-video pipeline (2026-07-25, storystudio-4lang-video-pipeline-handoff.md) — localized TTS for ONE frame's narrationTextEs/PtBr (a single sentence StoryStudio already translated, not a whole script), so this is a plain per-frame rung like voice.narrationBasic.tts — no webhookCompletion (unlike voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedQwen's whole-script variant, this never risks exceeding a single Lambda invocation). Same physical Qwen Voice Design/clone rung, split into its own key purely for billing/audit attribution.

voice.narrationBasic.ttsFrameLocalizedKo.note: fourLang per-frame full-video pipeline (2026-07-25) — localized TTS for ONE frame's narrationTextHi (or Es/PtBr when an explicit voiceId is sent, per RouteLocalizedTTS's data-driven engine choice). `fixed` is a fallback, not a hard override — see voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedKokoro's note. No webhookCompletion — per-frame text is a single sentence, same duration class as voice.narrationBasic.tts.

voice.narrationPremium.ttsFrameLocalized.note: Premium fourLang per-frame full-video pipeline (2026-07-28, porting Basic's 2026-07-25 redesign) — same rung as voice.narrationBasic.ttsFrameLocalizedQwen, split for billing/audit attribution only. Es/PtBr per-frame localized TTS via Qwen voice-clone (cloneArtifactUrl from the project-level voiceCloneArtifactUrlEs/PtBr fields).

Premium fourLang per-frame full-video pipeline (2026-07-28) — same rung as voice.narrationBasic.ttsFrameLocalizedKokoro (including the fixed-as-fallback behavior), split for billing/audit attribution only. Hindi per-frame localized TTS only (Qwen has no Hindi voices — see voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedQwen's note).

bgm.narration.note: Narration BGM (both tiers) — self-hosted ACE-Step on the dedicated bgm-s2t endpoint (6apg6j7suzuezw, ENDPOINT_ROLE=audio), split off flux-tts-s2t so once-per-project BGM never steals workers from the per-frame pipeline.

srt.narration.note: Narration SRT (both tiers) — self-hosted Whisper large-v3-turbo on the dedicated bgm-s2t endpoint (6apg6j7suzuezw, ENDPOINT_ROLE=audio), split off flux-tts-s2t.

video.narrationBasic.animate.note: Narration Basic animation — Flux-TTS-S2T animate (smooth Ken Burns), replaces the jittery local i2v render.

video.narrationBasic.merge.note: 2026-07-27: moved off the GPU pod — merge is pure ffmpeg muxing, no model inference, and was competing with image/TTS/animate for flux-tts-s2t's 6 workers (a real contributor to real execution timeouts). Also the first merge path to correctly PAD a shorter language's audio to the frame's shared duration (via durationS) instead of only ever trimming — see handlers/merge.ts.
Fallback only (kept for resilience during rollout) — Flux-TTS-S2T merge (animated video + TTS voice), -shortest trim-only, no padding.

video.narrationBasic.pipeline.note: Narration Basic one-shot per frame — Flux-TTS-S2T pipeline mode (image -> Kokoro TTS -> animate -> merge in one call, models resident in VRAM). Replaces 4 separate QM jobs/frame. caption:false + no bgm (SRT + BGM are project-level). Internal-only: no external one-shot equivalent, and basic is 100% flux-dependent anyway (animate/merge are flux-only), so no DR is lost.

video.narrationPremium.concat.note: Narration Premium video extension — Flux-TTS-S2T concat, duplicates a single Wan2 clip (video_urls: [url, url]) to cover TTS audio longer than Wan2's 7s max duration_s, before merge trims it to the real audio length. Internal-only: no external DR equivalent, but this only fires for the rare >7s-narration frame, not the hot path.

image.dialogueBasic.persona.note: Dialogue Basic narrator persona still — one per project, generated once before GenerateNarratorSegments so every segment (including 0) anchors on the same identity image (storystudio-dialogue-qm-sfn-handoff.md §4.2, §5). Skipped entirely when narrator.imageUrl is non-empty. Self-hosted Qwen-Image-Gen per the handoff doc's catalog table — same physical rung as image.dialogueBasic.t2i/image.explainer.t2i; split key purely for billing/audit attribution.

voice.dialogueBasic.tts.note: Dialogue Basic narrator TTS — per SEGMENT (30-45s script), not per frame (storystudio-dialogue-qm-sfn-handoff.md §3.3/§5). clone_artifact_url fast path when narrator.voiceCloneArtifactUrl is non-empty (runpod.ts); falls back to voice-design using voiceInstruct when empty. Same physical Qwen rung as voice.narrationPremium.tts.

video.dialogueBasic.narrator.note: Dialogue Basic narrator lip-sync — SHORT segments only (actualDurationSeconds <= 15s, routed by RouteNarratorLipSync in pipeline-stack.ts's narrator branch; segments are normally 30-40s, so this rung is a rarely-hit edge case in practice, not the common path). RunComfy InfiniteTalk mono endpoint (audio+image -> talking-head clip), $0.015/second billed. External, NOT part of the RunPod fleet (no counterKey/endpointId — see providers.runcomfy). Verified live 2026-08-08/2026-08-09 with both a synthetic tone AND a real TTS voice clip (real speech confirmed genuine dynamic lip movement, not just a duration match): output_duration == input_audio_duration exactly, no trailing pad, 624x352@25fps regardless of input resolution (storystudio-dialogue-qm-sfn-handoff.md §7.6.5). Poll-only (adapters/runcomfy.ts, supportsWebhook:false).

video.dialogueBasic.narratorRunpod.note: Dialogue Basic narrator lip-sync — LONG segments (actualDurationSeconds > 15s), which in practice is EVERY real segment (StoryStudio plans narrator segments at 30-40s, per product decision 2026-08-09). Same legacy named-route RunPod InfiniteTalk integration Documentary Premium already uses (lipsync.premium.video in foreground.json) — no new adapter code, adapters/runpod.ts already branches to POST {}/infinitetalk/run whenever a runpod rung carries no endpointId. $0.25/generation FLAT regardless of duration, vs RunComfy's $0.015/second — mathematical breakeven ~16.7s; the 15s threshold is a deliberate product simplification (not a rounding error — see RouteNarratorLipSync's comment in pipeline-stack.ts), not a safety margin above breakeven. Verified live 2026-08-09 with both a synthetic tone AND a real TTS voice clip (real speech confirmed genuine dynamic lip movement): submit/status/result all matched the existing adapter's expectations exactly, no new parsing needed.

voice.dialoguePremium.tts.note: Dialogue Premium per-character TTS — one call per TURN, not per line (storystudio-dialogue-qm-sfn-handoff.md §7.4/§7.9.2: half the calls, 12% shorter audio, better prosody than per-line-and-concatenate, and sidesteps hosting a concatenated track). Voice resolved per shot from voiceBank[characterId] via QM-build-turn-tracks. Same physical rung as voice.dialogueBasic.tts, split key for attribution.

video.dialoguePremium.monologue.note: Dialogue Premium single-speaker shots (kind:"monologue") — same physical RunComfy endpoint as video.dialogueBasic.narrator, split key for attribution. Coverage singles (2x mono calls) beat a fast/multi two-shot on every axis tested (mouth articulation, no trailing pad, no speaker-order constraint) — monologue is the dominant shot kind as of the 2026-08-08 planning revision (§1, §7.10). No trim needed post-generation (§7.6.5 — mono endpoint has no pad).

video.dialoguePremium.dialogue.note: Dialogue Premium two-speaker shots (kind:"dialogue") — RunComfy InfiniteTalk multi endpoint (left_audio+right_audio+image, exactly one exchange per call — §7.5). Verified live 2026-08-08: plays left track in full then right track in full (sequential, not mixed), output_duration = left_duration+right_duration+1.00s exactly on 4/4 real calls (not max(), not frame-quantised) — the +1.00s trailing pad MUST be trimmed post-generation (TrimToTrackLength, §7.4/§7.6.6) or a multi-shot film accumulates seconds of dead air. External, per-second billed, not RunPod-fleet-managed (no counterKey).

sfx.dialoguePremium.note: Dialogue Premium spot SFX (door slam, stone grinding, etc — authored per-shot moments, not gap-fillers, storystudio-dialogue-qm-sfn-handoff.md §7.7 rule 2). Same physical ACE-Step rung as bgm.narration; split key for attribution against the per-scene ambience-bed calls (which route through bgm.dialoguePremium with operation:"ambience", falling through this key's alias to the same model — no separate ambience.* key needed). Verified: requested duration_s honoured exactly (+0.024s mp3 frame padding only, no duration enum unlike Wan2 — §7.7.1).

sfx.dialogueBasic.note: Dialogue Basic per-frame spot SFX, added 2026-08-12 per storystudio-qm-sfx-vocal-audio-contract.md §4/§7.1 — mirrors sfx.dialoguePremium's bgm-mode-trick exactly (same physical ACE-Step rung, split key for attribution). Applied to a scene's Wan2 clip AFTER ReconcileSegmentTiming (once its duration is final), same ordering rationale as dialoguePremium's post-trim RouteShotSfx.

video.premium.i2v.note: Premium video I2V — self-hosted Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B 4-step Lightning (RunPod nd7wloyvj09xwy). Aspect ratio inherits from the input image.

video.dialogueRework.i2v.note: Dialogue rework video regen ONLY — deliberately does NOT include the self-hosted Wan 2.2 4-step Lightning rung from video.premium.i2v. Root-caused 2026-08-12 (dialogue-basic-qa-agent's first real 78-scene audit, 269 issues/47 scenes flagged): the self-hosted pod's 4-step Lightning distillation runs with prompt conformity effectively off (fast path, ~90s/gen) — 195 of those 269 findings were PROMPT_VISUAL_MISMATCH on the video, the model structurally dropping subtle/secondary motion cues regardless of prompt wording. Bumping the self-hosted pod's conformity to get real CFG costs 300-480s/gen instead of 90s; rather than pay that everywhere, only the already-flagged rework subset routes here, straight to Replicate's hosted (non-distilled) wan-2.2-i2v-fast — already proven as this exact ladder's realtime-jobType fallback. Shared key so video.dialoguePremium.i2vRework can alias it once Dialogue Premium gets its own QA/rework loop.

movie.premium.image.t2i.note: T2I standardized on self-hosted Flux Klein 4B. Was nano-banana-2 (higher quality, now DR fallback) — re-promote if movie-premium image quality regresses.
